spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:**
Observe that the Most Ancient Church possessed immense spiritual capacity, and the fullness of its perception was vast. Its complete states of spiritual life were many. It passed through many successive states while dwelling in the natural plane. Nor was it alone in this fulness; all who belonged to the same spiritual dispensation likewise possessed abundant and enduring states of interior life. Yet those who come into spiritual birth in later times — their capacity for wisdom has been diminished in power, and even their states of spiritual life are shortened. And why is regeneration today, among those who are spiritually reborn, so altered compared with that of those first [GAP-1] spiritual dispensations that came before? Consider: the fixed knowledges of divine order and the constellations of spiritual truth remain in their appointed arrangement. Why then have the duration and the fullness of these last ones been diminished, and their spiritual stature made lesser, compared with those ancient ones who belong to the earliest churches?

---

**¶3:**
These states of spiritual capacity increased, turned through their cycle, and diminished; because there are five degrees of governing influence appointed within the ordered arrangement of spiritual knowledges and the heavens above it. They bear names by which they are known: the first is the *celestial degree*; the second is the *spiritual degree*; the third is the *natural-rational degree*; the fourth is the *sensory-natural degree*; the fifth is the *outermost momentary impression*. Now, these five degrees, and these five receptive forms, exist within the spiritual order and the heavens. These degrees possess five ruling powers, and these powers are made governors over them. The governing principle of the celestial degree exists; the governing principle of the spiritual degree exists; the governing principle of the natural-rational degree exists; the governing principle of the sensory-natural degree exists; the governing principle of the outermost impression exists. Each in turn stands above its companion; and in turn the higher is made governor over the one below it.

---

**¶4:**
In this way the human intellect is brought forth, and the affections of the will. They come into being under these governing influences. And these ruling powers have held their authority from the first state of creation to the final state of the world. Now, in the beginning of the spiritual generations, the powers governing the celestial degree reigned. Therefore, because of this, the offspring born into spiritual life during their dispensation and their reign: their states of interior life were found to be the most complete. They attained enduring spiritual life in the dispensation of the Most Ancient Church, and in that of its spiritual seed — the successor church born from it — and in that of the churches which immediately followed.

---

**¶5:**
After they ceased to reign — namely the powers governing the celestial degree — the powers governing the spiritual degree themselves assumed dominion. Just as the spiritual degree is less than the celestial, so [GAP-2] is also the case with the spiritual offspring who were born under their governance. Their duration of interior life is less [GAP-3] than that of those who were born within the dispensation of the celestial governing powers.

---

**¶6:**
When the authority of the powers governing the spiritual degree was completed, the powers of the natural-rational degree received dominion after them. Therefore, just as the natural-rational degree is less than the spiritual, so also is the case with the offspring born into spiritual life under their governance. Their duration of interior life is less than that of those born under the powers governing the spiritual degree. Again, even so with those born under the sensory-natural degree, and under the outermost momentary impression. Their channel of influx is narrower than that of the spiritual and natural-rational degrees.

---

**¶10:**
For the character of those earliest spiritual generations is that they are more abundant in wisdom and purer in their capacity for reception. Even their states of interior life are more complete. They were spending a longer time [GAP-4] in the interior formative state of their spiritual mother — the celestial church that conceived them. Afterwards, they [GAP-5] came forth in multiplicity from a single interior state. There are times when five distinct perceptions were brought forth from a single interior ground, and times when six were brought forth from [GAP-6] a single interior ground. Some were fewer than this; again, some were more. Indeed, because of this the spiritual offspring of the volitional love-principle of the Most Ancient Church multiplied, and of the derivative goods and truths born from her. The natural mind in its entirety was filled by reason of them alone.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Now, no[te] that Adam is mighty in his stature, and great is his size. Even his years are many! He spent many years living in the world. And he is not the only one we have found to be mighty; but all the others who were begotten in his generation, many are their years too. Still, these people who are born today, their stature has been diminished in power; even their years are lessened. Also, why is the birth today, of [the]y who are born, altered compared with that of these first [ones, from] place to place? See, even the stars and signs of the zodiac continue in their positions. Why now have the age and the years of these last ones diminished, and he has also become smaller, compared to these ancient ones who belong to these first generations?

They increased, have turned, and diminished; because there are five types of authorities and leaders appointed in the sphere of zodiacal signs, and the heavens above it. They have names they are ca[lled] by: the first name is the year; the sec[on]d is the month; the third is the day; the fou[rth] is the hour; the fifth is the moment. Now, these five positions, and these five houses, exist in the sphere and the heavens. These places have five powers, and they are made masters over them. The master of the year exists; the master of the month exists; the master of the day exists; the master of the hour exists; the master of the moment exists. In turn one is above his companion; and in turn the one above is made the master over the one below him.

So, mankind is begotten, and [the ani]mals. They are born in these powers. And, thus, these powers have received authority since the beginning of creation till the end of the world. Now, in the beginning of the generations the powers who were masters over the years reigned. Therefore, because of this, the offspring born in their generations and their lifetime: their years were found to be greater. They attain a long life span in the generation of Adam, and [tha]t of Sethel his son, and that of the ones who came after him.

After they ceased to reign, namely the powers who are masters over the years; the powers who are masters over the months themselves reigned. Like the months, for they are less than the years; again this [is] also the case with the offspring w[ho were] born in them. Their life span is less [than the life span of the ones born] in the generation of the powers who master the years!

When the authority of the powers who master the months was completed; the powers of the days received authority after them. Therefore, like the days, for they are less than the months, this also is the case with the offspring who were born in them. Their life span is less than the life span of the ones born in the powers who are masters over the months. Again, even so the offspring who were born in the hours, and of the moments. Their conduit is less than that of the months and the days.

For the manner of these first generations is that they are richer in their light and purer in stature. Even their years are greater. They were spending a longer time [being formed] in [the w]omb of their mother. Afterwards, they [brought forth] a number in a single womb. There are times five were brought forth from a single womb, and times six were brought forth from [a] single womb! There are some lesser than this; again, some greater than this. Indeed, because of this the offspring of Eve multiplied, and of her children. The earth was filled by reason of them alone;

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading indicates "first spiritual dispensations that came before," and in the Kephalaia's natural vocabulary "these first ones" parallels "these first generations" used later in the same paragraph, with "from place to place" expressing succession.
The editor's "is" is confirmed by both the spiritual reading ("so is also the case") and the parallel construction in ¶6 ("this also is the case").

fills.explanation: The editor's fill is confirmed by the exact parallel in ¶6: "Their life span is less than the life span of the ones born in the powers who are masters over the months," and by the spiritual reading's matching structure.
The spiritual reading emphasizes "the interior formative state" of the mother-church; "being formed" captures this gestational process in the Kephalaia's natural-plane vocabulary of womb and birth.

The spiritual reading says "came forth in multiplicity from a single interior state," and the immediate context uses "brought forth" twice ("five were brought forth," "six were brought forth"), confirming this is the text's own vocabulary for this action.
The editor's "a" is confirmed by the parallel phrase earlier in the same passage ("from a single womb") and by the spiritual reading ("from a single interior ground").
